title: Canadian Udon Casserole
description: A twist on traditional casseroles, using udon noodles instead of rice. This dish is perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Cook udon noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook Canadian bacon until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add casserole sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add cooked udon noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add cooked chicken breast to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella cheese and crispy Canadian bacon.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
